note: Shape only (issue 72, ADRs 0142 to 0145). Placeholders for the per-attempt worker host pins that custodian-worker-ec2 binds (HostPins). No account, region, subnet, instance or image exists. Every UNMEASURED value stays UNMEASURED until recorded from the exact host under an authorized experiment (docs/arm64-sizing-measurement-plan.md).

image.rule: an immutable id built by a reviewed recipe, never a mutable alias or latest tag

launch.lifecycle: fresh per attempt; terminate after settlement; no stop, start, hibernate or reuse
launch.idempotency_token: derived from the full attempt identity by the adapter, never hand written

pins_recorded_per_attempt: request, approval, reservation, execution, attempt and fence
engine, adapter and scanner file digests (Node is the scanner-0 runtime artifact, architecture-specific)

permissions.control_role_for_provider: launch, describe, terminate and list on the owned inventory only; separate from the worker role
permissions.worker_role: read the inbound object prefix, write the outbound result prefix; nothing else

acceptance_pending: run_self_check on this exact image: Verified, no skipped success
measured startup, resident memory and headroom recorded as UNMEASURED until run
